670-1619-6151-6966.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6151-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing Underdark Explorer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.

2438-4276-5088-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
2438-4276-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2438-4276-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Turnabout with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Turnabout.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

Cast Aura Finesse by paying {U}, attaching the Aura to Codie and drawing a card (this is necessary because Codie's ability forces you to cast the Aura before Codie is on the battlefield).

Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
